title: Perl or Python Developer
description: We are looking for an experienced Scripting & Automation Engineer to lead the modernization of legacy backend scripts, automation workflows, and data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage advanced AI coding assistants to refactor and decouple backend applications and scripts written in Perl and Python away from Windows shared network paths (UNC shares like \\server\share and mapped drives) to run natively on local disk storage (C:\). You will combine multi-language scripting experience with prompt engineering and code review to migrate file access patterns, localize dependencies, and guarantee full functionality without network share bottlenecks. Key Responsibilities AI-Driven Path Refactoring: Direct AI tools to scan, identify, and refactor hardcoded UNC network paths, drive mappings, dynamic inclusions (use lib in Perl, sys.path in Python), and network file streams into clean, local-disk execution pathways across Perl and Python codebases. Dependency & Environment Localization: Package and isolate runtime dependencies locally—managing CPAN modules via local::lib/Carton in Perl, and Python virtual environments (venv, poetry, uv). Code Auditing & Quality Assurance: Perform line-by-line technical reviews of AI-generated code to prevent edge cases, enforce SOLID and dular design principles, resolve Windows path escape/formatting issues, and maintain high memory efficiency. Automated Testing Strategy: Build comprehensive unit and integration tests (Test::More for Perl, pytest for Python) to validate feature parity between network and local execution environments. Pipeline & Workflow Updates: Reconfigure Windows Scheduled Tasks, CI/CD pipelines, and PowerShell build scripts to execute scripts and tools natively on local disk storage. End-to-End Delivery: Take ownership of migrating legacy scripts, automation flows, and backend tasks from initial network path analysis through local verification and production rollout. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of hands-on software development and automation experience with Perl and Python in a Windows environment. Strong knowledge of Windows file systems (NTFS), network pathing mechanics (UNC format vs. local paths), process execution, and environment variables. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate code conversion, script generation, and refactoring. Deep understanding of dependency management tools across both stacks (CPAN, local::lib, Carton, pip, venv, poetry, uv). Proficient with Windows PowerShell scripting, Git version control (PR workflows, automated branch management), and CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Strong analytical skills to break complex legacy applications down into precise, prompt-driven tasks for AI agents. Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year Work Location: In person
